controls.label: Reopen draft
controls.description: Choose a workbench JSON draft up to 4 MB (4,000,000 bytes). Text exports and V2 reports cannot be reopened here. You will be asked before replacing existing notes.

controls.label: Work and outcome sought
controls.description: What starts the work, what counts as finished, and who benefits?

controls.label: Accountable workflow owner
controls.description: Use a role or safe reference. Who can authorise a change?

controls.label: Current process and main problem
controls.description: Include handoffs, waiting, review, rework and what already works.

controls.label: Current evidence and baseline
controls.description: Record source references, dates, sample and full-process quality/time. Separate observed, reported, forecast and unknown.

controls.label: People, errors and consequences
controls.description: Who could be affected? What happens if the result is wrong?

controls.label: Non-AI option
controls.description: Consider removing a step, clarifying ownership, an existing tool, training or ordinary automation.

controls.label: Possible AI contribution
controls.description: What could AI prepare for review, and what must it never do? Write not applicable if appropriate.

controls.label: Evidence and trade-offs for each option
controls.description: Compare likely outcome, setup, review, support, costs and failure consequences. Label assumptions.

controls.label: Preferred route and strongest alternative
controls.description: Why this route? What evidence would change your mind? No trial is required.

controls.label: Pilot boundary, or reason not to trial
controls.description: Define activity, scale, dates, users, tool/model/prompt version, exclusions and prohibited actions.

controls.label: Actual permission status
controls.description: Record who permits the tool, data, purpose and each action, with references and restrictions. Unknown is not permission.

controls.label: Trial runner, reviewer and continuity cover
controls.description: Who checks source evidence, can reject outputs and has time, authority and cover?

controls.label: Comparison and sample plan
controls.description: Which ordinary and awkward cases, selection rules and period? Log every attempt, including failures.

controls.label: Success conditions and unacceptable errors
controls.description: Agree these before testing. Include full-process outcome, quality and review effort.

controls.label: Stop, contain and recover
controls.description: Who may stop the trial? What triggers this? How are incidents contained and the ordinary workflow restored?

controls.label: Evidence basis
controls.description: Choose what these notes describe. This is a user-entered label, not verification.

controls.label: Comparison results and source references
controls.description: Record cases attempted, accepted, corrected and rejected; comparable baseline and trial periods; quality and full-process time.

controls.label: Review, rework, costs and actual benefit
controls.description: Include setup, support, failures and recovery. Count costs once. Separate observed benefit from forecasts and financial claims.

controls.label: Missing cases, changes and limitations
controls.description: What else could explain the result? Note tool/version changes and whether anyone independent checked the evidence.

controls.label: Known problems and unresolved material issues
controls.description: Keep adverse findings visible, even if other results are encouraging. If unknown, say so. Name a role, action and next step.

controls.label: V2 review position (self-reported)
controls.description: Leave not reviewed if you have not used V2. A complete record is never approval.

controls.label: Review reference, date, scope and limits
controls.description: Record the separate V2 report reference or why it is not applicable. Do not paste protected evidence.

controls.label: Unresolved questions and required review
controls.description: Who will inspect the evidence, handle issues or seek specialist advice? Record actions and review triggers.

controls.label: Human decision as reported
controls.description: Nothing is selected on your behalf.

controls.label: Decision-maker role and authority reference
controls.description: Who made the decision, and what authority do they hold for this exact scope?

controls.label: Decision date
controls.description: Leave blank until a decision has happened.

controls.label: Reasons, evidence and conditions
controls.description: Include disagreements and unresolved problems. A positive decision cannot make these disappear.

controls.label: Next action, responsible role and review date/triggers
controls.description: Record scope, conditions, continuity cover and what would require a fresh decision.
